description.value: Tequila Lounge is an authentic Mexican restaurant and bar situated in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood, offering traditional dishes—tacos, enchiladas, molcajete—alongside an extensive lineup of margaritas, mezcal cocktails, and Mexican beers. The venue doubles as a lively event space, regularly hosting live music acts, DJ nights, and open mic events. Touring cyclists seeking a full sit-down Mexican meal in the heart of downtown Vancouver will find a colourful, energetic spot with a broad menu spanning snacks to full mains.
